title: Rubio enjoyed major support among Venezuelans. Then came Trump’s oil deal.
summary_full: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will visit friendly governments in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru. But his support for the Venezuela oil deal is rankling some in the region.
